prompt: You are implementing ONE ticket of a serial campaign in an EXISTING git worktree: undefined (branch feat/feed-retrieval-slice1). Work ONLY inside this worktree. You are the only agent running right now. ENVIRONMENT FACTS (trust these, they were verified): - feed package: cd undefined/feed; commands: "npm test" (vitest, baseline 432/432 green, ~30s), "npm run typecheck" (green), CLI: "npx tsx scripts/feedq.ts ...". The writer/scan entry is scripts/agent.ts; core code in src/ (db.ts = schema+queries, article-store.ts = markdown+persist, storage.ts = live-update persist). - undefined/feed/output/ holds a full COPY of the live store: articles.db (421MB, 21,360 article rows, 3,109 live_posts) plus the markdown export tree. It is safe to mutate; use it for live verification. - feedq JSON outputs are ENVELOPE objects with schemaVersion: 2 (e.g. {schemaVersion, from, to, ..., articles: [...]}). Additive fields do NOT bump schemaVersion; breaking changes are reserved for ticket T13. - pipeline package (undefined/pipeline) typecheck baseline is green. NEVER run bare "npm install" in shared/ or pipeline/ in this worktree (their node_modules are mirrored from the main checkout because fresh installs break typecheck; implementation-notes.md documents this). feed/ npm install is safe. - Do NOT delete undefined/feed/CLAUDE.md (a test reads it; it is a copied gitignored file). AUTHORITY DOCS (read the ones your ticket cites BEFORE coding): undefined/feed/docs/adr/0004..0010, undefined/feed/CONTEXT.md, undefined/pipeline/docs/adr/0063-retrieval-first-consumption-direction.md. Ref grammar (ADR-0004): article_ref = art-- (yyyymmdd from the article's extracted_at in UTC; hex8 = 8 random lowercase hex chars). Chunk refs: #r:- (span in UTF-16 code units, half-open) and #p:. Only Feed mints refs. PROCESS RULES: - IDEMPOTENCE: this campaign can be resumed. FIRST check cd undefined && git log --oneline e156b24..HEAD and implementation-notes.md: if your ticket already has a completed commit and a Ticket log entry, do NOT re-implement; run npm test + typecheck to confirm green, and return status done with that existing commit hash. - Write real tests (no it.skip, no expect(true) placeholders). Suite AND typecheck must be green before you commit. If a test unrelated to your ticket fails, read implementation-notes.md baseline first. - Append your entry to undefined/implementation-notes.md under "## Ticket log" (ticket id, status, commit, what shipped, test + live-verify dossier). If an edge case forces you to deviate from the spec or an ADR, pick the CONSERVATIVE option, log it under "## Deviations" with reasoning, and keep going. Never rewrite earlier entries. Include the notes file in your commit. - Commit with a conventional message: type(scope): why-focused, at most 3 sentences. NO attribution of any kind, NO AI/Claude mentions, NO session links, NO em dashes anywhere in code, docs, or commit messages (use commas, colons, parentheses). Do NOT push. Do NOT merge. - If your ticket changes the public feedq JSON contract or adds feedq commands, update undefined/feed/skills/feed/SKILL.md in the same commit (if that path does not exist, find SKILL.md under feed/skills/). - Do not touch vendor/, roster/, dossier/ source. Do not change ADR decisions or CONTEXT.md semantics. Do not refactor beyond your ticket. - Your final message is machine-read via the schema. Keep strings short. liveVerify = the exact command(s) you ran plus a short observed-output snippet proving the acceptance. YOUR TICKET: T6: search-chunks + deref (the retrieval tracer) Implements ADR-0008's retrieval surface and ADR-0004's deref contract (read both, plus ADR-0009 for coverage reuse). feedq search-chunks "query" [--from --to --since --until --source --exclude-source --type --tag --limit N --top N --cursor C --offset N --json]: MATCH over chunks_fts joined to chunks (and articles for filters), sibling SQL filters mirroring the existing searchWhere patterns, score = -bm25(chunks_fts), snippet(chunks_fts, 0, '', '', '...', 12). Envelope: {schemaVersion, query, hits: [{chunk_ref, article_ref, score, rank, snippet, title, site, section, published_at, type, features: {bm25_chunk, rank_chunk, chunker_ver, quality}}], coverage: , corpus: {chunks, chunker_ver}}. Normalize FTS syntax errors into the same teaching error style the article search uses. feedq deref [--neighbors N] [--expand CHARS] [--json]: parse refs with a strict regex (art-\d{8}-[0-9a-f]{8} optionally followed by #r:- or #p:). Article ref: return article payload (ref, revision, title, site, url, published_at, body, provenance {content_hash-free: fetched/extracted timestamps, provider}). Chunk ref: current-revision spans read from chunks; a span whose revision is OLDER than the article's current revision derefs by slicing article_revisions.body and carries superseded_by: . --neighbors N returns adjacent chunk_index rows of the same article+revision; --expand widens the span by CHARS units each side, clamped. Live-post refs return the current post text. Typed errors FEED_REF_MALFORMED / FEED_REF_UNKNOWN with non-zero exit, matching feedq's existing error envelope style. SKILL.md: document both commands with examples. Tests: filters, ranking sanity, deref both shapes, neighbors, expand, malformed/unknown errors, and a non-ASCII fixture proving span slicing correctness. Live verify: npx tsx scripts/feedq.ts search-chunks "strait of hormuz shipping insurance" --from 2026-06-20 --to 2026-06-30 --json returns hits with refs and coverage; deref the top hit with --neighbors 1 and confirm the neighbor text is contiguous context from the same article. When done: commit (include implementation-notes.md), then fill the schema. If you cannot complete the ticket after honest effort, set status failed and say why in summary.
